none: PAS CAM-62FB45: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian. AD364-375, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVR[ITAV REI PVBLICAE]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse fields and exergue read: OF/I[...]//[...]. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 1.5g, diameter is 17mm
